release_notes: Cluster autoscaler noScaleUp visibility events now list node pools that were rejected only because of insufficient resources (NodeResourcesFit) first.
refreshMachinesCache now runs asynchronous refreshes after initial fetch, GetMachineType treats resulting cache authoritatively without falling back to GET MachineType requests

ComputeClasses whose name is longer than 63 characters are now reported as CrdMisconfigured (reason InvalidComputeClassName) and Health=False, and cluster autoscaler no longer tries to provision their minimum capacity.
Extended the histogram bucket boundaries for binpacking_node_groups_total,

Fixed NAP node templates predicting the iam.gke.io/gke-metadata-server-enabled and iam.gke.io/workload-identity-image-pull-enabled labels for ComputeClass node pools with workloadMetadata GCE_METADATA, Autopilot-managed node pools with image streaming, and during rollback-safe upgrades.
Enables nested virtualization support on E4 machine types.

Cluster autoscaler no longer repeats GCE MIG list and get requests to a zone after listing the MIGs in that zone failed earlier in the same loop, for example when the GCE read requests quota is exhausted.
